blocks.text: Following his sold out UK + EU headline tour, rising Australian pop artist Jude York today unveils his pulsating new single ‘Afternote’ via Warner Music Australia. Listen HERE. The whimsical disco inspired synth-pop track continues the theatrical direction of previous singles ‘Camilla’, ‘Those Were The Days’, ‘Monaco’,and ‘Cashew’. Written with Swedish collaborators. Nicki Adamsson (Tove Lo, NCT 127) and Litens (Icona Pop, John Newman), the energetic song is inspired by a deep longing to be someone’s romantic ending and main character in their story.
